name: cd-cross-border
description: DR Congo domestic-law screening of payments to nonresident service providers and recipients of investment or passive income for the 2026 income year. Distinguishes permanent-establishment facts, service execution from payment, gross service invoices from passive-income payments, and the August 2026 expansion covering royalties, software rights, know-how and other passive income. Includes withholding workpapers, declaration deadlines, payer responsibility, rounding and two executable examples. Use before paying a foreign supplier, shareholder or licensor. Treaty relief, sector privileges, mixed technical-service contracts and authenticated form completion need separate verification. This source-cited draft is not accountant attestation, a treaty table or authority to submit a return.
